description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the BulkWriteResultAckFlow class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.thingsearch.persistence.write.streaming package. It tests the handling of various bulk write outcomes such as full success, partial success with errors, unexpected exceptions, and index out-of-bound errors within MongoDB bulk write operations. The tests verify that the acknowledgement flow behaves correctly under different conditions and that the resulting log messages and responses are as expected.

classes.name: BulkWriteResultAckFlowTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the BulkWriteResultAckFlow class's behavior with various MongoDB bulk write result scenarios.

methods.name: stopActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test to clean up resources.

methods.name: allSuccess
methods.description: Tests the acknowledgment flow when all bulk write models succeed without errors.

methods.name: partialSuccess
methods.description: Tests the acknowledgment flow when some errors occur during bulk write, specifically simulating duplicate key errors and timeouts.

methods.name: unexpectedMongoSocketReadException
methods.description: Tests handling of an unexpected MongoSocketReadException during bulk write.

methods.name: errorIndexOutOfBoundError
methods.description: Tests behavior when bulk write errors contain an index out of bounds, indicating a consistency error.

methods.name: runBulkWriteResultAckFlowAndGetFirstLogEntry
methods.description: Processes the WriteResultAndErrors through the acknowledgment flow and retrieves the first log message.

methods.name: generate5WriteModels
methods.description: Utility method to generate a list of 5 mock write models, alternating between delete and write models, for testing purposes.

methods.name: expectUpdateThingResponse
methods.description: Extracts and verifies an UpdateThingResponse message from the TestProbe, simulating response expectation.
